remarks: Charming one-bedroom, one-bath condo at Admiral’s Walk offering spectacular marina and Lake Erie views. This inviting home features gleaming hardwood floors, abundant natural light, and a comfortable, well-designed layout. The spacious living room includes built-in bookshelves, additional storage, and a convenient corner desk, with sliding glass doors leading to an enclosed patio overlooking the marina and Lake Erie. The dining area, accented by a beautiful chandelier, opens to a bright and tidy kitchen featuring tile flooring, dishwasher, refrigerator, and electric range. A utility closet conveniently houses the washer, dryer, and mechanicals. The generous bedroom offers large windows with exceptional views, a walk-in closet, and its own sliding glass door providing access to the patio. The en-suite bath features a tub/shower combination, with convenient additional access from the hallway. Residents enjoy a sleek, secure lobby, fitness room, storage area, and one-car garage. Ideally located just steps from Canalside and the newly constructed $110 million Ralph C. Wilson Jr. Centennial Park, this is a wonderful opportunity to enjoy waterfront living in the heart of Buffalo. Come experience the views, natural light, and exceptional location this Admiral’s Walk condo has to offer!
